d: The Toy with the Blind, coming in from the right, and said. The old woman has her face covered from under her eyes by a poor zendado.

Barnabas, the Blind, Isèpo, Zuàne. Then six Sgheri. La Gioconda, Enzo, later Laura, Alvise. The People brings in triumph the Winner of the Regatta, who keeps the green pallium high (the flag of the prize). - Women, Marinai, Children with flowers and garlands, Zuàne sad in the background.
The Blind, Gioconda, Alvise, Laura, Barnabas, Chorus, then Enzo.
Barnabas, Poscia Isèpo, indì for a moment Gioconda and Blind.
A Masquerade enters the courtyard, followed by the People singing and dancing. He poses a Barnabotto, Gioconda and Blind.
Chorus, Barnabas and Isèpo. Barnabas is dressed as a fisherman with a net in his hand.
Enzo, Marinai and Mozzi; Ours, the Master of sails, the Pilot.
Alvise, alone, while the cadence of the serenade is at its last notes; observes the empty vial on the table.

Very sumptuous room next to the funerary cell, beautifully parade to party. Large door in the bottom to the left, a similar to the right, but this all closed by a drapery. - A third door in the wall to the left. Knights, Dames, Masks enter. Alvise will move them meeting receiving and complimenting those who enter. The Paggio is next to him.
The record, Barnabas, the Blind, Enzo.
Lonely toy, darkly absorbed in her thoughts.
Meanwhile you will see Enzo coming from the calle, find the door ajar, come in.
Lonely toy, then Barnabas in the calle.
